The numbers used in the subtraction scenarios are all up to 20, such as starting with 20 erasers, 10 apples, 15 cookies, or 12 stickers.
Only seed 103 contains a concrete or pictorial model (an EmojiPictorial payload rendering 20 chicks). The other seeds are text-based word problems without any visual or concrete aids.
All seeds describe the operation of subtraction using contextual framing, explicitly stating that a certain number of items are 'Taking away' from a starting group.
All sampled seeds consistently and explicitly use the exact phrase 'Taking away' in their problem descriptions (e.g., 'Taking away 10 blocks leaves...').
